id:
Closes the dashboard and returns to where you were.
Esc is a cascade: it first dismisses an open peek or clears an active filter, and only exits once nothing else is pending.
Rebind this action to a different key to exit directly.
english:
Closes the dashboard and returns to where you were.
Esc is a cascade: it first dismisses an open peek or clears an active filter, and only exits once nothing else is pending.
Rebind this action to a different key to exit directly.

id:
Copies only the block's identifier: a tool call's command line or a file block's path, not the body.
Handy to re-run a command or paste a path elsewhere.
Use lowercase y to copy the full content instead.
english:
Copies only the block's identifier: a tool call's command line or a file block's path, not the body.
Handy to re-run a command or paste a path elsewhere.

id:
Copies the selected block's body to the clipboard: message text, full tool output, or a code block's contents.
Offered only on blocks that support copy.
For just the command or file path, use Y instead.
english:
Copies the selected block's body to the clipboard: message text, full tool output, or a code block's contents.

id:
Cycles the dispatch mode for agents you launch from the dashboard: Normal, Plan, then Always-Approve.
Plan has new agents plan before changing files; Always-Approve runs their tools without prompting.
Mirrors the in-session Shift+Tab cycle, applied to new dispatches.

Cycles the dispatch mode for agents you launch from the dashboard: Normal, Plan, then Always-Approve.

Mirrors the in-session Shift+Tab cycle, applied to new dispatches.

id:
Detaches the running foreground Execute so it keeps working in the background while you read, queue prompts, or start something else.
Track and resume it from the tasks pane (Ctrl+G).
Only meaningful while a foreground Execute is actually running.
english:
Detaches the running foreground Execute so it keeps working in the background while you read, queue prompts, or start something else.

id:

id:
Folds or unfolds every scrollback entry at once, unlike e which toggles only the selected row.
Collapse a long transcript to scan headers, then expand it all back.
Thinking blocks have their own toggle, Ctrl+E.
english:
Folds or unfolds every scrollback entry at once, unlike e which toggles only the selected row.

id:
Folds or unfolds the selected scrollback entry to hide or show its full body.
Handy for skimming long tool output or reasoning.
Related: E folds/unfolds every entry, Ctrl+E toggles all thinking blocks.
english:
Folds or unfolds the selected scrollback entry to hide or show its full body.
Handy for skimming long tool output or reasoning.
Related: E folds/unfolds every entry, Ctrl+E toggles all thinking blocks.

id:
Fuzzy-search every action and slash command, then run it by name.
Useful when you don't remember a key binding.
Also opens with ? while the scrollback is focused.
english:
Fuzzy-search every action and slash command, then run it by name.
Useful when you don't remember a key binding.

id:
Inside a session overlay, stops the attached agent and closes it, returning you to the dashboard list.
Requires confirmation: press Ctrl+X twice.
Ctrl+. still opens the cheatsheet here; only Ctrl+X is taken over by stop.
english:
Inside a session overlay, stops the attached agent and closes it, returning you to the dashboard list.

Ctrl+. still opens the cheatsheet here; only Ctrl+X is taken over by stop.

id:
Interrupts the agent's current turn and stops generation, keeping the session open.
Ctrl+C cancels when the prompt is empty; with a non-empty draft it clears the prompt first and leaves the turn running.
Esc never cancels a turn; pressed mid-turn it shows a reminder to use Ctrl+C.
It stops the turn, not the app; use the quit shortcut to exit.
english:
Interrupts the agent's current turn and stops generation, keeping the session open.
Ctrl+C cancels when the prompt is empty; with a non-empty draft it clears the prompt first and leaves the turn running.
Esc never cancels a turn; pressed mid-turn it shows a reminder to use Ctrl+C.
It stops the turn, not the app; use the quit shortcut to exit.

english: Jump to next turn at viewport top

id: Jump to previous turn at viewport top
english: Jump to previous turn at viewport top

id:
Leaves the attached session overlay and returns to the dashboard list, without stopping the agent.
Also reachable via q on the scrollback, a neutral Esc, or the close button.
To stop the agent instead of just detaching, use Ctrl+X.
english:
Leaves the attached session overlay and returns to the dashboard list, without stopping the agent.
Also reachable via q on the scrollback, a neutral Esc, or the close button.
To stop the agent instead of just detaching, use Ctrl+X.

id:
Microphone capture for dictation, bound to Ctrl+Space (or F8: handy where Ctrl+Space is taken, e.g. macOS input-source switching; use Fn+F8 on a laptop).
Behavior follows the Voice capture setting: toggle (press to start, press again to stop) or hold-to-talk (hold to record, release to stop), where hold needs a Kitty-protocol terminal and falls back to toggle elsewhere. `/voice` toggles everywhere.
Speech is transcribed straight into the prompt.
english:
Microphone capture for dictation, bound to Ctrl+Space (or F8: handy where Ctrl+Space is taken, e.g. macOS input-source switching; use Fn+F8 on a laptop).
Behavior follows the Voice capture setting: toggle (press to start, press again to stop) or hold-to-talk (hold to record, release to stop), where hold needs a Kitty-protocol terminal and falls back to toggle elsewhere. `/voice` toggles everywhere.
Speech is transcribed straight into the prompt.

id:
Moves focus from the prompt to the scrollback so you can navigate the transcript.
Tab works in both simple and vim scrollback modes.
Esc is reserved for the cancel / clear / rewind policy, not focus.
english:
Moves focus from the prompt to the scrollback so you can navigate the transcript.
Tab works in both simple and vim scrollback modes.
Esc is reserved for the cancel / clear / rewind policy, not focus.

id:
On a busy top-level row, Ctrl+X cancels the running turn. Once the row is idle, press Ctrl+X again within 2s to permanently delete the session.
On a subagent row, Ctrl+X kills the subagent.
english:
On a busy top-level row, Ctrl+X cancels the running turn. Once the row is idle, press Ctrl+X again within 2s to permanently delete the session.
On a subagent row, Ctrl+X kills the subagent.

id:
Opens a picker to set the working directory that newly dispatched dashboard agents run in.
Launch agents against a different repo or folder without leaving the dashboard.
Affects new dispatches only, not agents already running.
english:
Opens a picker to set the working directory that newly dispatched dashboard agents run in.
Launch agents against a different repo or folder without leaving the dashboard.
Affects new dispatches only, not agents already running.

id:
Opens the Agent Dashboard: a list of all your running and recent agents to monitor and switch between.
Works from anywhere, including the welcome screen and inside a session.
From there you can dispatch, attach, stop, group, and reorder agents.
english:
Opens the Agent Dashboard: a list of all your running and recent agents to monitor and switch between.
Works from anywhere, including the welcome screen and inside a session.
From there you can dispatch, attach, stop, group, and reorder agents.

id:
Opens the current prompt draft in $VISUAL or $EDITOR, falling back to vi when neither is set.
Saving and closing the editor returns the updated text to the composer; it does not send the prompt.
Available in minimal mode for ordinary attachment-free drafts.
english:
Opens the current prompt draft in $VISUAL or $EDITOR, falling back to vi when neither is set.
Saving and closing the editor returns the updated text to the composer; it does not send the prompt.
Available in minimal mode for ordinary attachment-free drafts.

id:
Opens the extensions manager for MCP servers and plugins: see what's connected and the tools they add.
Use it to confirm an integration loaded or browse available tools.
Distinct from settings, which holds general app options.
english:
Opens the extensions manager for MCP servers and plugins: see what's connected and the tools they add.
Use it to confirm an integration loaded or browse available tools.
Distinct from settings, which holds general app options.

id:
Opens the model picker to switch the model for this session; the choice applies to later turns.
Bound to Ctrl+M, but while the prompt is focused that chord toggles multiline instead.
Reach it from the scrollback or the command palette.
english:
Opens the model picker to switch the model for this session; the choice applies to later turns.
Bound to Ctrl+M, but while the prompt is focused that chord toggles multiline instead.
Reach it from the scrollback or the command palette.

id:
Opens the selected block in a focused, scrollable full-screen viewer.
Best for long tool output, large files, or code you want to read away from the surrounding transcript.
Esc returns to the conversation.
english:
Opens the selected block in a focused, scrollable full-screen viewer.
Best for long tool output, large files, or code you want to read away from the surrounding transcript.
Esc returns to the conversation.

id:
Opens the session browser to resume or switch between past conversations.
Select one to reattach to its full history. `/resume` does the same.
Separate from the Agent Dashboard (Ctrl+\), which manages many live agents at once.
english:
Opens the session browser to resume or switch between past conversations.
Select one to reattach to its full history. `/resume` does the same.

id:
Opens this keyboard cheatsheet.
Browse with j/k, expand a row's inline help with e, or press Enter for a shortcut's full detail page.
Bound to both Ctrl+. and Ctrl+X; the bar advertises whichever your terminal sends reliably.
english:
Opens this keyboard cheatsheet.
Browse with j/k, expand a row's inline help with e, or press Enter for a shortcut's full detail page.
Bound to both Ctrl+. and Ctrl+X; the bar advertises whichever your terminal sends reliably.

id:
Pins or unpins the selected agent so it stays at the top of the list regardless of sorting or grouping.
Keep the agents you care about in view as others come and go.
Pins persist across dashboard sessions.
english:
Pins or unpins the selected agent so it stays at the top of the list regardless of sorting or grouping.
Keep the agents you care about in view as others come and go.
Pins persist across dashboard sessions.

id:
Rewinds the conversation to an earlier turn, discarding later turns. File changes made after that turn are left as-is.
Pick a turn from the list; a running turn is offered for cancel first. When Confirm before rewind is on (default), each pick asks Yes / Yes, and don't ask again / No. Picking "Yes, and don't ask again" turns the setting off in /settings.
Destructive: later turns are dropped.
Also reachable idle with an empty prompt via Esc Esc (within 800ms), same as `/rewind`.
english:
Rewinds the conversation to an earlier turn, discarding later turns. File changes made after that turn are left as-is.
Pick a turn from the list; a running turn is offered for cancel first. When Confirm before rewind is on (default), each pick asks Yes / Yes, and don't ask again / No. Picking "Yes, and don't ask again" turns the setting off in /settings.
Destructive: later turns are dropped.
Also reachable idle with an empty prompt via Esc Esc (within 800ms), same as `/rewind`.

id:
Runs a shell command without leaving the chat: type ! at the start of an empty prompt, then the command.
The command output is captured into the scrollback.
Delete the leading ! to go back to a normal prompt.
english:
Runs a shell command without leaving the chat: type ! at the start of an empty prompt, then the command.

Delete the leading ! to go back to a normal prompt.

english: Send now while running (cancels the current turn)

id:
Sends a message to the agent mid-turn without cancelling it (interject), so you can steer or add context while it keeps working.
Plain Enter while a turn is running queues a follow-up for later; this chord merges composer text into the current turn instead.
With an empty composer, bare Enter (or this chord) force-sends the top queued follow-up from the prompt: no need to focus the queue pane. On the queue pane, this chord force-sends the selected row.
Reach for it to correct course without losing the turn's progress.
english:
Sends a message to the agent mid-turn without cancelling it (interject), so you can steer or add context while it keeps working.
Plain Enter while a turn is running queues a follow-up for later; this chord merges composer text into the current turn instead.
With an empty composer, bare Enter (or this chord) force-sends the top queued follow-up from the prompt: no need to focus the queue pane. On the queue pane, this chord force-sends the selected row.
Reach for it to correct course without losing the turn's progress.

id:
Shows or hides the agent's reasoning (thinking) blocks across the whole transcript in one keypress.
Reveal how the agent reached an answer, or hide reasoning to focus on results.
Separate from E, which folds every entry regardless of type.

id:
Shows or hides the prompt queue.
The queue lets you line up follow-up prompts while a turn is running; each is sent automatically when the agent finishes.
Local macOS VS Code family: Ctrl+4 primary (Ctrl+; / Ctrl+' alts). Otherwise Ctrl+; with Ctrl+' alt.
english:
Shows or hides the prompt queue.
The queue lets you line up follow-up prompts while a turn is running; each is sent automatically when the agent finishes.
Local macOS VS Code family: Ctrl+4 primary (Ctrl+; / Ctrl+' alts). Otherwise Ctrl+; with Ctrl+' alt.

id:
Shows or hides the tasks pane, which lists background tasks and their status.
Use it to monitor or return to work you sent to the background with Ctrl+B.
A side pane; toggle off to reclaim width.
english:

id:
Shows or hides the todo pane: the agent's live task checklist for the current work.
Watch what it plans to do and what's left as the turn runs.

id:
Starts a fresh session with empty scrollback and context.
Requires confirmation: press it twice (the first press arms, the second starts)
so you don't discard the current conversation by accident.

id:
Stash your current prompt as a draft.
Ctrl+S sets the draft aside and clears the composer. Ctrl+S on an empty composer restores it. The draft also restores by itself after you send your next prompt. Use Alt+S if your terminal swallows Ctrl+S.
One draft at a time: a new stash replaces the old one.
english:
Stash your current prompt as a draft.

id:

Plan keeps the agent planning first and writes no files; Always-Approve runs every tool call without asking.
